comparison.objective: Disinfect an IV connector, seat a syringe, and flush it; the candidate tunes and locks an industrial shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests sustained pad contact and rubbing, contamination-aware sequencing, precise luer alignment, seating, and plunger travel. Candidate tests recessed hex-key engagement, fastener torque, collar adjustment, and assessment of impact dynamics.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires 15 seconds of qualifying scrubbing before syringe contact, followed by centered seating and a 3 cm plunger stroke in the latest specs. Candidate requires two compliant carriage stops and a post-lock retention test.
comparison.reason: Both include small-part alignment and insertion, but their central mechanisms, safety constraints, and demonstrated outcomes are different. Candidate drift/rebound/overload thresholds remain numerically unspecified.
